description:
Recognise reserved profile-application targets with one `VirtualPath` predicate applied after classification.

## Background

`reject_reserved_application_targets` (`crates/jit/src/commands/profile.rs:3017-3035`) matches raw `.jit/events.jsonl`, `.jit/profiles`, `.jit/tmp` and `.git` prefixes on package target keys before they are classified (`profile.rs:2062-2069`). It is called at `commands/profile.rs:2054` and `commands/init.rs:400`. Classification already rejects `.jit/tmp` (`repository_state/path.rs:233-242`). `is_bootstrap_lock` (`path.rs:28-31`) is the precedent shape for a `VirtualPath` predicate. No test covers `ReservedApplicationTarget`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `VirtualPath::is_reserved_application_target` recognises the event log, the applied-profile directory and a worktree `.git` component, and is the only reserved-target matcher.
- [hard] REQ-02: Both call sites classify targets first and apply the predicate to the classified paths, and the raw prefix matcher is gone.
- [hard] REQ-03: A test shows that applying a package with each reserved target fails with `ReservedApplicationTarget`.
title: One VirtualPath predicate recognises reserved application targets
